given: a warehouse operator is filing a stock record for a SKU at a location
when: the filed quantity is below zero
then: the filing is rejected with a clear message that names the quantity field, and no stock record is created or changed

independence.rationale: This asserts the write-time rejection of a negative quantity with a field-naming message, an outcome independently breakable from the happy-path create (AC1) and the collision update (AC2): an implementation can persist and update correctly yet still accept a negative quantity or reject it with an unnamed error.
